'''Zephee''' was a wind spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who warned Ewoks when a storm was coming. "Zephee" was a popular name given to female Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as an [[Zephee/Legends|Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="SW6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zephee was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
